description: This ACCC dataset provides data on mobile sites and coverage maps within Australia collected under the ACCC's Audit of Telecommunications Infrastructure Assets record keeping rules. Contents: annual mobile site spreadsheets for each of the three national mobile network operators (Optus, Telstra and TPG) from 2018 onward, frequency-band coverage maps submitted by the operators, additional technology-level coverage maps aggregated by the ACCC where operators did not provide them, a data interpretation guide (version 6) and a letter from Telstra on a changed 4G outdoor coverage methodology. Revisions on 8 September 2022 corrected a small number of Telstra and Optus 2020 and 2021 site files, and coverage map file names now indicate their standard of coverage. The reference period is 31 January 2018 to 31 January 2026, and the record was updated on 21 September 2026. Producer: the ACCC, with contact datastrategy@accc.gov.au. Coverage: Australia. Access: CSV and file downloads on data.gov.au with no login. Licence and cost: Creative Commons Attribution 2.5 Australia, free. Caveats: coverage is modelled and reported by operators under different standards, so the interpretation guide must be read before comparing operators. Simulation uses: site locations and coverage layers support resilience, coverage-gap and hazard-exposure analysis of mobile networks. Related records: Measuring Broadband Australia (data-accc-measuring-broadband-australia) and the mobile coverage program datasets (data-australia-mobile-coverage-program-datasets).
